x: The prize for the best entry, judged by a panel led by Mrs Sheena Lucas, was awarded to Brian Pritchard's Boat Race Four ably coxed by Bill Laws.
The evening commenced at the reception with each member or guest being individually announced by the toastmaster and greeted by our president, Bill Lucas and his charming wife Sheena.
Sheena (Mrs Bill) Lucas and Harry Porter have both recently undergone operations on their troublesome backs and we wish them a complete and speedy recovery.
